text:
Thalia (Finance): FYI vendor AylaTech billed UK VAT on sandbox credits (INV-AY-0924). They say it's a billing system bug and that they're EU-registered. Can we hold refund until verified? cc @Gina Legal @Ben Tax
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-AY-0924 uploaded by @AylaTech 109. File: INV-AY-0924.pdf
Ben Tax: Needed from vendor to validate: 1) VAT registration number and a gov VIES screenshot, 2) reissued invoice with 0% VAT or explicit reverse charge language, 3) statement of place of supply (B2B vs B2C). Without proof we can't zero-rate.
Gina Legal: For SaaS to UK business customers the reverse-charge applies when supplier is outside UK and buyer has a valid UK VAT number. If AylaTech is EU VAT-registered they shouldn't charge UK VAT on B2B sales. We need the invoice to state: "Supply subject to reverse charge 1 VAT to be accounted for by the recipient."
Hiro (APAC Ops): Vendor replied: VAT ID "MT12345678" and says charge was applied by their default UK tax rule. They offered to refund the VAT or reissue.
Ben Tax: I'll run the VIES check. If VIES returns valid, request reissued invoice and a short indemnity email explaining the overcharge. If VIES fails, ask for official VAT registration certificate and business registry extract.
Thalia (Finance): Putting INV-AY-0924 on payment hold and flagging for refund once corrected invoice is in. SLA to vendor: 3 business days to reissue or refund.
Gina Legal: Suggested vendor copy (paste):
```
Please reissue invoice INV-AY-0924 without UK VAT and include the statement: "Reverse charge: VAT to be accounted for by the recipient." Alternatively, please refund the VAT amount of A320 immediately and provide proof of refund. Attach VIES verification or national VAT certificate.
```
Ben Tax: VIES lookup: MT12345678 returned as ACTIVE. If they reissue we can clear hold. I'll log verification in the tax binder. :white_check_mark:
Thalia (Finance): Thanks all. I'll note this in the refunds tracker and wait for either reissue or refund proof before issuing credit. Closing thread when credit shows on bank feed. :money_with_wings:
